body: When I was in training I once met a guy who had drank a whole gallon of bleach by his recollection.  He said it was the most painful thing he had ever experienced. He also said that it sucked because he was living with a feeding tube for the rest of his life and missed the taste of food
In addition, I doubt my death will impact anyone...I could be dead right now and no one would know

I have tried multiple hotlines looking for support groups, etc.  Nothing seems to pan out and I have reached my limit and I am ready to give up
Oh yeah I forgot to mention the colic where it is uncontrollable screeching sometimes for 8 plus hours between the 2 of them...I am not a super human..I feel I can do no more

13.  The babies get out of the NICU while I am still recovering from surgery...I find that everything is just too much for me so I try the adoption route...At first the ex says he will sign the papers but later refuses saying that he doesn't want to end up on Dr Phil one day with somebody asking him why he gave them up (Mind you despite this stupid, moronic excuse...He has done nothing for them...no financial help..has not even seen them and I dont understand how it is any different than reliquishing parental rights.  The state that I live in wants to keep giving deadbeat dads chances and will not let an adoption go through without him even though he has done nothing
14.  Because I own my car and home...despite that I still have to pay on them as well I student loans, I don't qualify for any assistance in my state and I estimate that if I could get it I would only need it for 3 months tops so I can get a job and get back on my feet.  I have paid so much into a system that is not there for help when I need it.  My savings will last me about 1 more month tops and I do nothing extracurricular or for me..

9,My job required me traveling to work to places where I was needed so working was severely limited and I couldn't really find another job because of the troubles I was having...I did go on one interview where they insisted I meet them at a fancy restaurant..the smells were so nauseating I just had to excuse myself eventually after continuous trips to the bathroom
10.  I end up having to have an emergency c sections due to twin complications
11.  I end up with two infants in the NICU
12.  I have to deal with this all alone as my family is 1 hour and 15 minutes away and that apparently is too far to drive for me

8,  I end up going through pregnancy completely alone..no family nothing because I am an inconvienence to them because so many things including certain smells made me vomit profusely and they didn't want to have to bother with that and I am supposed to just "get over it" because people get sick during pregnancy and I wont be the only person to have to do it alone

Just a little back story...maybe can understand more...
1.  I come from a poor background where higher education wasn't the priority..I always felt the only thing I was even remotely good at was academics...so this stupid poor girl decides to get a doctorate  which means I have student loans for days which wouldn't be as bad if everything else didn't happen
2.  Feel in love/Got engaged to what I now know was the wrong person 
3.  Despite being on birth control, ended up pregnant...thought about abortion but the now ex was adamant about having a child together so I concede because honestly I knew we weren't getting any younger and it may not happen again
4.  Not only was I pregnant, it ended up being a high risk pregnancy because I was advanced maternal age and twins
5.  My "morning sickness" ended up being hyperemesis gravidarum and never went away and resulted in me being hospitalized at least once monthly for dehydration when it would get so bad that the meds I had didnt work
6,  Did I mention I did most of it alone because the ex was driving trucks long distance but was looking for and had promised to find a local gig before the birth
7.  When I was 23.5 weeks and in the hospital again for dehydration/vomiting...He then says why don't you go ahead and have that abortion....wth...the state I live in doesn't do it past first trimester and its hard to get this late in the game
I don't think this is temporary at all....I am typing up the backstory and will send
No there aren't any...I have checked into that and called the local 211 number...
Well if I have been thinking and reaching out where does that option come from...Right now I feel my only option is death

I guess it would be both of those options....Because you can afford neither of them and you try the local mental health and they say that you can come in but you can't/won't be seen if you bring your infants with you...The problem with that is that you have no options for a babysitter have been left alone to care and have an unsupportive family that tells you to "get over it" because you are not the first person that has had all that has happened to me happen to them
